description: This file implements a PasswordHasher class used for hashing passwords with salt, utilizing HMACSHA512 for cryptographic operations. It provides methods to hash passwords asynchronously and to dispose of resources.

classes.name: PasswordHasher
classes.description: A class that provides password hashing functionality using HMACSHA512.

methods.name: Hash
methods.description: Asynchronously hashes a password combined with a salt, returning the hash as a byte array.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Disposes of the HMACSHA512 cryptographic service object.
